notes: Every null below is a real number only you can read: the store consoles, the Anthropic price page and your own Supabase data. The app never ships a default price.
Run pm run pricing to see what is missing; pm run pricing:strict fails until every field is filled and every check passes.
Prices are the customer price you set in App Store Connect / Google Play Console (tax included where the store shows it that way), in the row's currency.

WAVE ECON.4: costInputs is model based. featureModels names the model each feature really runs on, models holds each model's USD per million tokens, and avgTokensPerCall is measured per feature. pm run cost:export then pm run cost:report -- <csv> --matrix prints the models / featureModels / avgTokensPerCall / analyze block from real telemetry; paste it here.

analyze.callsPerMonth is the monthly contract-scan allowance you decide per plan. The server only caps analyze-contract API calls per day (200 Pro / 400 Professional, one scan is several calls), so a monthly scan cap you promise here must also be enforced.
analyze.extractCallsPerScan = OCR / PDF text extraction calls per scan; analyze.deepShareProfessional = share of Professional scans on the deep model (0 to 1). Use 1 for a strict worst case.

sources.tokenPrices: Anthropic pricing page, one entry per model named in featureModels (USD per million tokens, models.<model>.usdPerMTokInput / usdPerMTokOutput). pm run cost:report -- <csv> --matrix fills them from the price table in scripts/lib/claude.mjs; check them against the page.
sources.avgTokens: npm run cost:export (reads public.ai_cost_daily with your service key from the environment), then npm run cost:report -- <csv> --matrix. Or the SQL editor: select feature, plan, model, calls, avg_input_per_call, avg_output_per_call from public.ai_cost_monthly order by month desc. Wait until each feature has real paid calls.
sources.storeFeeShare: Your current Apple (Small Business / standard) and Google subscription fee rate, as a share: 0.15 or 0.30. Use the higher one you can face.
sources.taxShare: Share of the customer price that goes to VAT / sales tax in that row's country (0 when the store price already excludes it).
sources.usdPerUnit: Value of one unit of the row currency in USD, from your payout report or a rate you trust. Dated by asOf.
sources.featureModels: The model each feature runs on: supabase/functions/legal-ask (MODEL), pro-tools (MODEL), analyze-contract (default / deep / fast map). pm run check:models prints them.
sources.scanVolume: analyze.callsPerMonth is your own policy (telemetry has no user ids). extractCallsPerScan and deepShareProfessional come from --matrix.
